rows.07:17d50: But where would the key be?
rows.07:17d70: I came to the nurse's office.{p}
rows.07:17d94: ...It's locked.{p}That's right, I have to find the key first.
rows.07:17dd0: There doesn't seem to be anything here.{p}Maybe I'd better search somewhere else.
rows.07:17e1c: Just to be sure, I came back to the nurse's office one more time.{p}
rows.07:17e78:
When I opened the door, a stifling smell hit my nose.
Something raw-smelling, and sweet...
What is this?
Without thinking, I glanced down at the floor.{p}
rows.07:17f00:
"Hh...!"
A sound escaped me before I could stop it.
The one lying on the floor was, without a doubt, Hosoda.
His eyes were bulging, and blood was running from his mouth.
He must have bled a great deal.
Everything from his chin down to his neck was stained red.
He looked like he was already dead.
Between his fingers, bent as if in agony, I saw a blackish lump.
This was... his tongue!
Hosoda had died with his tongue cut out.
And on top of that, he'd been made to clutch it in his own hand.
I staggered and bumped into the wall.{p}
rows.07:180c0:
With a start I turned around, and there were words scrawled in blood.
This suits a blabbermouth perfectly☆
...This is insane.
Nausea welled up in me.
But I swallowed hard and held it down.{p}
rows.07:18180:
This is no time for that.
I don't have time.
Make yourself believe that what's lying there is just a thing.{p}I told myself that.
rows.07:18208:
Just to be sure, I came back to the nurse's office one more time.
Of course, I made sure not to look at Hosoda... no, at the thing lying on the floor.{p}But come to think of it, the smell seems a little fainter than before.
rows.07:182c0: I decided to go to the nurse's office.{p}
rows.07:18314: I decided to examine the bed.{p}
rows.07:18338: There didn't seem to be anything particularly suspicious...{p}
rows.07:18374:
Just as I thought that, I heard a strange sound.
If I had to describe it, it was like something desperately trying to hold back ragged breathing...?{p}What should I do?
rows.07:1844c:
In the darkness, I saw two glowing eyes.
"Waaah!"
Was it me who screamed, or was it him?
Either way, I came to my senses a split second sooner.
I jumped up onto the bed.
"Gweh!"
I heard a pained voice.
"I... I can't breathe... get off me, pleeease..."
That voice was Hosoda's.{p}
rows.07:1855c:
Big as he was, there was no way he could flip the bed over with me on top of it.
"You were lying in wait to kill me, weren't you? Too bad, but I'm not letting you get me."
Through the thin mattress, I could feel Hosoda squirming.
"Now you're going to tell me where the ampoule is."
Shoes and all, I stomped down on the bed with a bang.
"S... stop it... I can't breathe... I'll tell you if you get off me, okay?"
He really did sound like he was suffering.
I decided to get off the bed.
It wasn't as if I wanted to hurt Hosoda.
But the instant I stepped down from the bed...{p}
rows.07:1878c:
"Raaaaaargh!"
Hosoda sent the bed flying.
I never thought he still had that much strength left★
The hard metal-frame bed slammed into me.{p}
rows.07:18810: Dragging the curtain with me, I crashed into the windowpane.{p}
rows.07:18854:
The glass shattered with a crash.
Luckily, the curtain had shielded me from the glass.
Without it, I'd have been cut up all over.
Hosoda came at me, thrusting out his thick arms.
If those got hold of me, I'd never have the strength to break free.
I picked up one of the scattered shards of glass.
It was pure reflex.
I thrust the shard in my hand out as hard as I could.{p}
rows.07:189cc:
"Gyaaah☆"
The glass shard sliced off Hosoda's left ear.
"It hurts! It hurts, my ear!"
Hosoda howled, clutching his ear and trying to stop the bleeding.{p}What will you do?
rows.07:18a78:
I peered behind the curtain.
Just then...{p}
rows.07:18b6c: All right, then, let's search the medicine cabinet.{p}
rows.07:18b94:
But it wouldn't open.
It seemed to be locked.
I settled for just looking through the glass.
From what I could see, all sorts of medicine bottles were lined up inside.
Among them were several ampoules that looked like the one I was after.
I strained my eyes.
Depending on what I found, I might have to break the cabinet's glass door.{p}...But the ampoule burned into my memory wasn't there.
rows.07:18cd0: I looked at the medicine cabinet once more.{p}
rows.07:18cf4:
There were lots of medicines I'd never even seen before.
Couldn't one of these do the same job as the antidote?
...But wait.
It wasn't impossible that a side effect might make the poison even stronger.{p}I'd better not, after all.
rows.07:18dd8:
I settled for just looking through the glass.
From what I could see, all sorts of medicine bottles were lined up inside.
Among them were several ampoules that looked like the one I was after.
I strained my eyes.{p}
rows.07:18ec4:
Sending the bed flying, Hosoda burst out from behind it.
Damn.
I should have checked the bed!
But it was too late now.{p}
rows.07:18f34:
On instinct, I twisted aside and dodged.
Hosoda couldn't stop in time and plowed into the medicine cabinet.{p}
rows.07:18fa8:
The glass shattered with a crash.
"It hurts, it hurtsss..."
Hosoda groaned, his whole face covered in blood.
It looked like the glass had sliced off his ear.{p}What will you do?
rows.07:1903c: There doesn't seem to be anything here.{p}I gave up and decided to search somewhere else.
rows.07:19078:
I shoved my hand into my pocket.
The feel of a plastic handle.
Who'd have thought something like this could feel so reassuring?
I raised the screwdriver and hurled it.{p}
rows.07:19120:
"Gyaaah!"
The screwdriver stabbed into Hosoda's eye.
Damn.
I rushed over, but Hosoda paid me no mind, rolling around and screaming.
I felt a little sorry for him, but my life was on the line too.
I grabbed Hosoda by the shoulder.
"Where's the ampoule? Answer me."
"Uh... uhh..."
Hosoda didn't answer.
Maybe he couldn't.{p}
rows.07:19268:
I gripped the screwdriver still stuck in his eye.
"If you don't answer, I'll shove this in even deeper!"
Fear came over Hosoda's face.
"Ah... th-the old school building..."
The old school building!
He didn't look like he was lying.
I gave a firm nod.
"Got it."
I yanked the screwdriver out hard.
"Gwahk!"
Letting out a strange noise, Hosoda passed out.
I'd never dreamed I could do something this drastic.{p}
rows.07:19408:
I ran for it.
"Wait!"
Behind me, I heard Hosoda's voice.
Like I'd wait.
I circled around to the side of the bed and found a basin full of disinfectant.
As Hosoda lunged after me, I spun around and threw it at him.
"Gah!"
While he flinched, I dashed for the door.
"You're not getting away!"
Just as I tried to slip past, Hosoda thrust out his arm.{p}
rows.07:1953c:
His thick arm caught me square in the throat.
My breath stopped.
I staggered, and he swept my legs out from under me.
I fell, and Hosoda sat astride me.
Disinfectant dripped from his hair.
Hosoda wrapped both hands around my neck and squeezed.
"Heh heh heh... Can't breathe?"
He brought his face close to mine.
At this rate, he was going to kill me.
Just then, my hand touched something hard.
I grabbed it on reflex and swung it.{p}
rows.07:196c8:
I'd hit Hosoda in the head.
Hosoda collapsed on top of me.
He was really heavy.
With a struggle, I crawled out from under him.
Hosoda didn't get up.
Blood was flowing from inside his ear.
Maybe he was hurt pretty badly.
I kicked his huge body over with the tip of my shoe.
"Where's the ampoule? Answer me."
"Uh... uhh..."
Hosoda didn't answer.
Maybe he couldn't.{p}
rows.07:1981c:
"If you don't answer, I'll kick you to death!"
Hosoda's face, gasping with pain, went from pale to a deathly gray.
Was he feeling the fear of death?
Serves him right.
Now he'd have some idea how I felt.
Hosoda's mouth flapped open and shut.
"Ah... th-the old school building..."
The old school building!
He didn't look like he was lying.
"Got it."
I nodded, then kicked Hosoda in the head.
"Gwahk!"
Letting out a strange noise, Hosoda passed out.
I'd never dreamed I could do something this drastic.{p}
rows.07:199e8:
"Sorry about that, really."
I apologized.
Hosoda looked up at me with teary eyes.
"I don't want to do this, you know. But I've got no choice if I want to live. You understand, don't you?"
"Uh..."
Hosoda nodded, again and again.
It was as if he thought he'd be dead the moment I got in a bad mood.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.07:19b18:
"Are you all right, Hosoda?"
I put on a sickly-sweet voice.
How hypocritical.
I disgusted myself.
But it couldn't be helped.
I wanted to live, too.
Seeing how I was acting, Hosoda seemed to get some strange hope.
His face brightened, and he looked at me, fawning.
"That was mean. But you're amazing, you know. I bet you could get into the Murder Club."
He was trying to smile through the pain.
"The Murder Club, see, is a secret club, and Master Hino is its president. Want me to ask Master Hino for you? Ask him to please make you a member? Then we could all get together and kill anyone we can't stand."{p}
rows.07:19d28:
All right, then I'll run.
...But where to?
There's no getting out of the school.
I'm no better than a cornered rat.
Somehow, I was starting to get angry.
"Ngh!"{p}
rows.07:19dd0:
I kicked Hosoda hard.
"Ow! It hurts! It hurts! Stop it, please, I'll tell you where the ampoule is!"{p}
rows.07:19e3c: "How dare you try to kill me!"{p}
rows.07:19ee0:
"Why are you trying to kill me?!"
Hosoda looked up at me timidly.
"Tell me, or I'll kill you!"
"I-I'll tell you. I'll tell you..."
By now Hosoda's face was a sniveling mess.
"I like curry, you see."
Huh?
What is this guy talking about?
I thought he was making fun of me, but Hosoda's face was dead serious.
"The other day I ordered curry in the cafeteria, but it was sold out. So I asked, and they said {a}... you bought the last serving."
"Wha..."
I was speechless.
Apparently Hosoda meant every word.
But I wasn't about to get killed over something like that!{p}I was so angry I couldn't stand it.
rows.07:1a110:
"Why are you trying to kill me?!"
Hosoda looked at me blankly.
"I already told you that."
That's right.
This guy had tried to kill me over curry rice, of all things.
He'd said so himself, with a face that said 'What's wrong with that?'{p}I have to calm down.
rows.07:1a220:
"Where's the ampoule?"
I asked what I most needed to know.
"If I tell you, will you spare me?"
...This guy!
Just how far is he going to push his luck?
Without thinking, I clenched my fist.
Hosoda's face suddenly went stiff.
"S-sorry. I'll talk. Where the ampoule is, right? I know where it is."
"Then talk. If you tell me the truth, maybe I'll spare you."{p}
rows.07:1a374:
Should I just let him go?
But he tried to kill me.
If I let him go, wouldn't I just be making another enemy for myself?
...No, it's fine.
I'll let him go.
This kind of thing just isn't like me.
Hosoda is my senior, after all.
As a first-year, it weighs on me to keep doing this to him.
"...Go."{p}
rows.07:1a4cc:
Hosoda looked at me as if he couldn't understand.
"I said go! Before I change my mind."
"Ah... okay, okay."
Hosoda hurriedly got to his feet.
He scurried eagerly toward the door.
Was this really the right thing to do?{p}
rows.07:1a5ac:
...The instant I thought that, Hosoda's hands shot out for my neck.
Before I could get away, he was choking me.
"Ngh... ugh."
"It's just like Master Hino said!"
Hosoda shouted gleefully.
"We're the chosen ones, so no matter what trouble we're in, we'll be saved for sure! Master Hino knew everything all along☆"
He squeezed tighter and tighter.
I was blacking out.
It's... over.
The moment I lost consciousness, there was a dull crack.
It was the sound of my neck breaking.{p}
rows.07:1a740:
I tore up a sheet and made a makeshift rope.
I roughly tied Hosoda up.
"Ow! Don't be so rough!"
"Shut up!"
Ignoring him, I yanked the knots tight, then tighter.
At last, Hosoda burst into tears.
"Stop it, pleeease... you'll break my bones. I'll tell you where the ampoule is, so please don't tie me up..."{p}
rows.07:1a868:
I opened the cupboard and peered inside.
Were all these bound documents the students' medical records?
I could see the ampoule wasn't here, but maybe something in here was written about Hino and the others' weak points★{p}Should I look through them?
rows.07:1a948: I'd better not.{p}Right now, I can't waste even a minute.
rows.07:1a984: I looked through the medical records.{p}
rows.07:1a9a4: ...There didn't seem to be anything worth noting in this file.{p}Should I keep looking?
rows.07:1aa04: I'd better not.{p}Right now, I can't waste even a minute.

Lots of cavities.

Somewhat overweight.
